name: OWASP MCP Security (Secure MCP Server Development + Third-Party MCP)

controls.title: Secure MCP Architecture
controls.description: Prefer STDIO/Unix sockets locally; TLS 1.2+ and schema validation for remote; isolate users and sessions with per-session state and quotas.

controls.title: Safe Tool Design
controls.description: Signed tool manifests verified at load; formal onboarding/approval; validate descriptions against behaviour; expose only minimal fields to the model.

controls.title: Data Validation & Resource Management
controls.description: Treat all data as untrusted; enforce JSON schemas on tool inputs/outputs; sanitize and size-limit; quotas and timeouts per session.

controls.title: Prompt Injection Controls
controls.description: Structured JSON tool calls; HITL on high-risk actions; LLM-as-judge for policy; one task, one session (context compartmentalization).

controls.title: Authentication & Authorization
controls.description: OAuth 2.1/OIDC mandatory for remote; short-lived scoped tokens; prohibit token passthrough (confused deputy); centralize policy enforcement.

controls.title: Secure Deployment & Updates
controls.description: Secrets in vaults never exposed to the LLM; hardened non-root containers; network segmentation; pinned/scanned dependencies; CI/CD gates; safe error handling.

controls.title: Governance
controls.description: Cryptographic integrity and version pinning; security peer review; immutable audit logs; non-human identity governance.

controls.title: Tools & Continuous Validation
controls.description: SAST with MCP rules and MCP-scan; SCA on dependencies; runtime isolation (seccomp/AppArmor); continuous SIEM monitoring; OpenSSF Scorecard.

controls.title: Third-Party Trust Minimization
controls.description: Do not assume servers are trustworthy; registry-only discovery; verify origin/signatures; pin versions; staged rollout; sandbox in containers; JIT scoped access.
